verdict.rationale: The skill writes its deliverables as open-format files: production-ready SVGs, rendered PNGs and a favicon/app-icon/web-manifest set. It is itself packaged in the open Agent Skills format, so it works in any agent that supports skills, which makes leaving easy. There is no documented 'export all data' capability, and nothing states that every artifact (such as brand guidelines and boards) lands in open, locally owned formats. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of complete data export and ownership, documented formats for every kit artifact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
